choices.content: Construct a line through A perpendicular to CA, and choose any point on this line as A′
Join C to A, construct \(\angle ACA'=90^\circ\), and mark off \(CA'=AB\)
Join C to A, construct \(\angle ACA'=90^\circ\) in the counterclockwise direction, and mark off \(CA'=CA\)

question.prompt: Triangle ABC is rotated counterclockwise through \(90^\circ\) about C. How do you construct the image of A?

solutions.explanation: To construct an image under rotation, join the center of rotation to the point, construct the angle of rotation in the specified direction, and then mark off a length on the new ray equal to the original segment, namely \(CA'=CA\).
solutions.title: Construct the direction and preserve the radius
